usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and Salesmate holds sales activity, so “New Task Created in Project” can log work via “Create Activity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Activity” in Salesmate
bestTemplate.why: A task made in Todoist appears as an activity in Salesmate, so sales sees the work without asking.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so “Create Activity” in Salesmate follows a scheduled check.
